items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: Satch told him, he said, he said, Alvin told me that I never played in Storyville.

ctx.x: So, then Tyree Glenn came into the room and Satch told him, he said, he said, Alvin told me that I never played in Storyville. He said, find out that I didn't even know where Storyville was.
